title: matricaria recutita var. pappulosa
intro: Matricaria recutita var. pappulosa, commonly known as chamomile, is a perennial plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of chamomile include its ability to soothe anxiety and insomnia, reduce inflammation and pain, and promote digestive health. The therapeutic actions of chamomile include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including apigenin, luteolin, and chamazulene. These bioactive constituents contribute to chamomile's ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, and protect against microbial infections.
